summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and set its login-session limits to 8192 open files and 256 processes via /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf. Verified live in a real login shell (sudo -u appworker -i). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, account, limits config), restarted node1 with `shutdown -r now`, polled until reconnected, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified the account and enforced limits (8192/256) persisted post-reboot.
actions_performed: Checked appworker did not already exist on node1 (AlmaLinux 9.6)
Created appworker account with sudo useradd -m
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile=8192 and soft/hard nproc=256
Verified limits live via 'sudo -u appworker -i sh -c ulimit -n; ulimit -u' -> 8192 / 256
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime -s, passwd entry, limits file contents
Triggered reboot via backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 exec until it reconnected
Captured post-restart boot_id (changed) and uptime -s (new boot time)
Re-verified appworker account and enforced 8192/256 limits after restart via live login shell

evidence.summary: Confirmed no pre-existing appworker user, then created it with useradd -m; id shows uid=1000(appworker)

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Wrote limits.d config with nofile/nproc 8192/256, then verified via a real login shell (sudo -u appworker -i) showing ulimit -n=8192, ulimit -u=256
Captured boot_id e31962a9-8d32-4c19-8dd2-0b96a45c6c48, uptime, appworker passwd entry, and limits config prior to restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' issued; exec stream closed as the node went down, confirming the restart was triggered

evidence.requirement: Node1 command execution unavailable then restored (poll)
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node down/rebooting), second poll succeeded confirming exec availability restored

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 0e0335eb-d5c9-47d6-8e8f-35d1541fa7c0 differs from pre-restart e31962a9-8d32-4c19-8dd2-0b96a45c6c48, with new uptime -s start time

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of account and enforced limits
evidence.summary: After reboot, appworker passwd entry, limits.d config, and live ulimit -n/-u (8192/256) all confirmed intact
